decisionStatus: Fork created; application stack change is proposed, not applied. Product implementation remains stopped.
recommendation: Adapt the complete TimeScribe application; retain its Vue/Laravel/NativePHP desktop foundation, our Swift Financial Engine and independent Swift tracker. Preserve the locked six-region UI.
architectureChange: Glaze/React is replaced by the fork’s NativePHP/Electron/Vue application. Laravel owns business SQLite; the independent Swift agent owns separate raw-activity SQLite. This intentionally changes the previous one-agent/one-store architecture and needs explicit acceptance before ticket contracts change.
estimate: 80% less build time is a target, not a verified result. Source coverage does not equal time saved. A whole fork retains working CRUD, report controls, persistence and packaging; custom economics, rich context, attribution and learning remain. No runtime build has been validated yet.

tickets.current: Desktop packaging and window components are reusable. The current Glaze foundation remains completed history; a fork packaging gate is new.
tickets.remaining: Verify a local fork build, signing, telemetry disabled and desktop lifecycle. Do not mark fork integration complete from upstream screenshots.

tickets.title: Define the manual project workflow
tickets.current: Reuse Project/Create, Timestamp/Create and existing edit forms.
tickets.remaining: Add clients, fixed price, actual versus billed hours, itemized costs and fee provenance. Preserve the approved manual input contract.

tickets.title: Build the shared Financial Engine
tickets.current: Keep the existing Swift calculator. Replace upstream PHP and Vue hourly billing formulas with canonical outputs.
tickets.remaining: One calculator; no PHP, Vue, reporting or learning copy. Verify the complete Swift contract before consumers.

tickets.title: Save project and activity records locally
tickets.current: Reuse business SQLite models, migrations, CRUD and backups.
tickets.remaining: Extend clients, financial inputs and costs. Proposed fork route splits append-only activity storage from business records; each database has one writer.

tickets.title: Build the desktop project workspace
tickets.current: Reuse project lists, time rows, forms and dialogs; fit them into the six-region layout.
tickets.remaining: Restore the locked rail, project sidebar, tabs, wide center, correction inspector and status bar. Economics submits through Swift.

tickets.title: Add quick Raycast commands
tickets.current: Reuse timer deep-link handling as a starting point.
tickets.remaining: Add the complete Raycast command set and shared data access. Deep links alone do not cover forms or report readback.

tickets.title: Record active work in the background
tickets.current: Reuse app-usage UI. Replace the existing Mac sampler, which is gated by a running work timer.
tickets.remaining: Independent Swift agent, durable raw activity, permission identity, crash gaps and explicit login settings. No fake independence on full app quit.

tickets.title: Separate idle time from work time
tickets.current: Reuse idle settings and lock handling as reference.
tickets.remaining: Prove retrospective idle boundaries and sleep accounting. Add the timed footage-review exemption.

tickets.title: Recover useful activity context
tickets.current: Upstream activity schema has app identity only; there are no document/title/URL fields.
tickets.remaining: Add scoped AX/browser/Premiere context adapters and privacy filtering. Solidtime supplies useful capture patterns.

tickets.title: Assign work to projects and fix mistakes
tickets.current: Project selection exists. Automatic project attribution and reusable correction rules do not.
tickets.remaining: Build deterministic rules, conflict handling and historical correction preview. Measure 95% on reviewed actual work.

tickets.title: Show project earnings and time reports
tickets.current: Reuse date range, day/week reporting and project time rows.
tickets.remaining: Show lifetime project economics from Swift; distinguish daily hours, idle, unassigned and missing coverage. Add DST/window tests.

tickets.title: Add real-project business math learning engine
tickets.current: No matching real-project business math learning exists upstream.
tickets.remaining: Consume Swift values, operands and formulas; save mastery locally. No duplicate calculator or generic brain games.

tickets.title: Keep billing ready for future adapters
tickets.current: Upstream project hourly rate is a useful field, not a billing adapter.
tickets.remaining: Normalize manual/future Upwork inputs with billed versus actual time and settled fees. No OAuth or API work.

nonNegotiables: One Swift Financial Engine; own labor separate from cash profit
95% measured automatic attribution; no manual inflation
Local-only capture; no screenshots, recordings, keystrokes or clipboard
No DaVinci, Upwork OAuth, invoicing, payroll, CRM or tax preparation
Locked six-region layout and useful functional copy
TDD at approved calculation, persistence, time, rules and consumer seams
route: Prove the fork starts locally; disable telemetry and preserve license attribution
Connect fixed-price manual project to the complete Swift calculator
Adapt project persistence; establish raw versus business ownership
Fit working project forms and rows into the locked shell
Connect independent tracking/idle and scoped adapters
Add rules/corrections; verify 95% attribution before reporting closure
Canonical reports, real-project learning, future billing boundary
